b: performs the actions of the people of Paradise
وإن أحدكم ليعمل بعمل أهل النار
acts with the actions of the people of the Hellfire
help a man with his mount
intended to perform a good deed
intended to perform an evil deed
nearly as great as the earth
ran away to the laden ship
threw him onto the open shore
Indeed in that is a sign
in the name of Allah is its course
حتى اذا اتوا على واد النمل
not equal are the good deed
You did not create this aimlessly
الا ان تدعوا الله بصالح اعمالكم
bowl of milk was in my hand
a dog was going round a well
go to such and such village
I am just as My slave thinks
never been seen by an eye
